title: LWBC Land Policy: Grazing, effective 15 November 2004
madeUnder: Policy of Land and Water British Columbia; not an enactment
transcribedFrom: published PDF, text layer checked against the page

provisions.heading: Disposition of timber on Crown grazing leases
quotes: The Crown reserves the right to all timber located on any Crown grazing leasehold
the proposal is to be reviewed with the grazing lessee to determine whether the lessee has any objections
For older leases (issued prior to November 2004) the lessee's rights in this regard may vary from lease to lease

provisions.heading: Lessee consents
quotes: Formal consent is not required when a timber tenure is to be issued directly to the lessee.

provisions.heading: Lessee withholds consent
quotes: For older leases (granted prior to November 2004) where consent is required and it is withheld by the lessee
timber rights will not be granted over the grazing leasehold until such time as the lease expires
